questions: Do you have a tremor, especially at rest?
Do you notice stiffness or rigidity in your limbs?
Have you noticed any slowness in your movements or daily activities?
Did your symptoms start on one side of the body?
Have you ever been prescribed levodopa or other Parkinson's medications?
Do you have any balance problems or falls?
Is there a family history of Parkinson's disease or tremor?
Have you noticed any difficulty moving your eyes, especially looking up or down?
Do you have any problems with memory or thinking clearly?
Have you had any urinary problems such as urgency or incontinence?
Do you ever feel dizzy or lightheaded when standing up?
Do you have difficulty with tasks like using utensils or buttoning clothes, even though your hands seem normal?
Have you ever noticed one arm or leg acting as if it has a "mind of its own"?
Are you currently taking any medications, including zonisamide?
Do you experience visual hallucinations (seeing things that are not there)?
Have you or your bed partner noticed acting out dreams during sleep (yelling, punching, or moving violently while asleep)?
Do you have fluctuations in your alertness or concentration throughout the day (sometimes clear, sometimes confused)?
Did the memory problems start before or at the same time as the movement slowness?
Do you have any problems with smell?
orders: Trial of levodopa challenge to assess dopaminergic responsiveness
MRI brain to assess for structural abnormalities
DAT scan to assess dopaminergic neuron integrity
Repeat examination after a formal therapeutic trial of levodopa/carbidopa 300/75 mg total dose
